License texts for Rust dependencies whose published crates omit them.
Each text comes from the same upstream project: alloc-stdlib from
alloc-no-stdlib (rust-alloc-no-stdlib), ext-php-rs-build and
ext-php-rs-introspection from ext-php-rs, and polars-parquet-format from
polars-parquet (MIT) plus the Apache License 2.0 text for its Apache Thrift
portions. scripts/package-binary.py includes them in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.
